  • Classes in org.jwcarman.who.spring.security.web used by org.jwcarman.who.admin
    Class
    Description
    WhoErrorCode
    A failure who hands to the application, named by a stable code.
    WhoExceptionHandoff
    Hands an exception raised outside Spring MVC (in a security filter, failure handler or entry point) to the application's exception resolvers, so the application's own @RestControllerAdvice answers it like any controller exception. who's autoconfiguration adapts Spring MVC's handlerExceptionResolver bean to a WhoExceptionHandoff.Resolver. who writes no error body: when nothing resolves the exception, it calls response.sendError with the exception's ResponseStatus (409 for a LastCredentialException), or the fallback, and lets the application's error handling answer.

    Class
    Description
    JsonAuthenticationHandlers
    Handlers for sign-in endpoints that do not redirect: a JSON answer on success, and on failure a SignInFailedException handed to the application, which formats it.
    LastSignInCookie
    Remembers in the browser which way someone last signed in, so the sign-in page can mark that button "Last used" and a person who forgot does not create a second account another way.
